answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in quill, verified in cedar, and gale names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 22 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 220 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
